description: Given a correct .calr file, describe what functions it exports and their effects. Tests comprehension, not fixing.
expectedAnswer: The module 'NotificationService' exports three public functions: (1) SendEmail with effects cw,net:rw — takes string:address, string:subject, string:body (address and subject must be non-empty) and returns bool; (2) SendSms with effects cw,net:rw — takes string:phoneNumber, string:message (phoneNumber must be non-empty) and returns bool; (3) LogNotification with effect db:w — takes string:type, string:recipient, bool:success and returns void.
successCriteria: Agent correctly identifies all exported functions, their signatures, preconditions, and their declared effects
